name: risk.mq5
summary: This EA is a risk management utility that monitors account exposure and open positions, providing risk calculations and position sizing guidance rather than executing trades autonomously. It calculates risk parameters such as lot size based on account balance and stop-loss distance, serving as a companion tool for manual or automated trading. The utility does not open, modify, or close positions on its own.
summary_zh: 该EA是一款风险管理工具，用于监控账户敞口和持仓情况，提供风险计算和仓位规模参考，而非自主执行交易。它根据账户余额和止损距离计算风险参数（如手数），作为手动或自动交易的辅助工具。该工具本身不会开仓、修改或平仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA属于工具类程序，不具备自主交易策略，不根据市场信号开仓或平仓。其核心功能是基于用户设定的风险百分比和止损距离，计算出合理的交易手数，帮助交易者控制单笔交易风险。工具可能监控账户整体风险敞口，包括总持仓量、浮亏比例等关键指标，并在风险超过阈值时发出警报。部分功能可能包含资金管理建议，如根据账户净值动态调整仓位规模。整体定位为风控辅助工具，而非独立交易系统。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is a utility-class program that does not possess an autonomous trading strategy and does not open or close positions based on market signals. Its core function is to calculate appropriate trading lot sizes based on user-defined risk percentage and stop-loss distance, helping traders control per-trade risk exposure. The tool likely monitors overall account risk exposure, including total position volume, floating loss ratios, and other key metrics, issuing alerts when risk exceeds predefined thresholds. Some features may include money management recommendations, such as dynamically adjusting position sizing based on account equity. Its overall positioning is a risk-control auxiliary tool rather than a standalone trading system.

parameters.name: RiskPercent
parameters.description: 每笔交易的风险百分比

parameters.name: LotSizeMethod
parameters.description: 手数计算方法（0=固定百分比，1=ATR动态）

pros: 提供科学的风险计算方法，帮助交易者控制单笔风险敞口
可作为辅助工具配合任何交易策略使用，通用性强
实时监控账户风险状态，防止过度杠杆和爆仓
pros_en: Provides a scientific risk calculation method, helping traders control per-trade risk exposure
Can be used as an auxiliary tool alongside any trading strategy, offering strong versatility
Monitors account risk status in real-time, preventing excessive leverage and margin calls
cons: 作为工具不产生直接交易利润，仅提供辅助信息
缺少对市场波动率（如ATR）的自适应风险调整功能
无法自动执行风控操作（如自动减仓），仅依赖人工响应
cons_en: As a utility, it does not generate direct trading profit, only providing supplementary information
Lacks adaptive risk adjustment based on market volatility (e.g., ATR-based dynamic sizing)
Cannot automatically execute risk-control actions (e.g., auto position reduction), relying solely on manual response
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态止损和仓位计算功能，适应不同市场波动环境
加入自动风控执行能力，如超过最大风险时自动平仓或减仓
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and position sizing to adapt to varying market volatility environments
Incorporate automatic risk-control execution, such as auto-closing or reducing positions when maximum risk thresholds are breached

risk_points: 作为工具类EA，不直接参与交易，风险极低
若交易者过度依赖工具计算而忽略市场实际波动，可能导致风控不足
risk_points_en: As a utility EA, it does not directly participate in trading, posing extremely low risk
If traders over-rely on the tool's calculations while ignoring actual market volatility, risk management may be insufficient
